First closed beta of Verso for jailbroken Kindles (hard-float firmware 5.16.3+).

- EPUB reading with bundled Literata, system and custom fonts, footnotes, book search, highlights, notes and bookmarks.
- Calm library with Home, folder browser, search, finished books and KOReader progress and highlight import.
- Offline StarDict dictionaries with English and Russian word forms, and built-in Wi-Fi transfer.
- Signed in-app updates with automatic rollback, plus problem reports via Settings or KUAL (downloadable from Wi-Fi transfer → Files → Reports).
